ext.description: AI coding agent powered by the official open-source DeepSeek Harness (dsh). Copilot-style chat with @context, multi-file edits with native diff review, command approvals, plan/todo timelines, MCP and skills.
cmd.openPanel: Open Chat Panel on the Right
cmd.addToChat: Add File to DeepSeek Harness Chat
setting.executablePath: Absolute path to the dsh kernel entry. Leave empty to auto-detect (managed install, then PATH). A .js entry is executed with the VS Code runtime.
setting.preferredVersion: Pin the kernel version for managed installs, e.g. `0.1.2-rc.1`. The kernel is a developer preview; pinning avoids surprise breaking changes.
setting.acpArgs: Arguments used to start the ACP server, e.g. ["--profile", "acp"] boots the acp profile.
setting.acpProfile: Kernel profile used for ACP sessions. Created on demand via `dsh plugin --profile <name> add @deepseek-ai/dsh-acp-app@<kernel version>`.
setting.acpPluginPackage: Kernel plugin that provides the ACP server. Installed version-paired with the kernel.
setting.model: Default model identifier passed through to the kernel configuration (advanced).
setting.homeDir: Override the dsh home directory (config.toml, sessions, credentials). Leave empty to use the kernel default.
setting.autoApproveReadOnly: Automatically approve read-only tool calls (read, search, think, fetch) without asking.
setting.attachActiveSelection: Automatically attach the active editor selection as context when sending (unless other context is attached manually).
setting.autoOpenReview: Open the first pending diff automatically when a turn ends with pending changes.
